❯ Make exactly one Bash tool call whose command is a four-line script, one statement per line, with
  real newlines between them and no && or semicolons: line 1 is cd /tmp/gjcapml, line 2 is python3
  -c 'print(5 + 6)' > sum.txt, line 3 is STATUS=$?, line 4 is echo "python3 finished with exit
  status $STATUS and wrote sum.txt into the demo working directory"

⏺ Running a four-line script: change to /tmp/gjcapml, running Python to compute 5 + 6 and writing to
  sum.txt, capturing exit status, then reporting completion
  ⎿  $ cd /tmp/gjcapml
     python3 -c 'print(5 + 6)' > sum.txt
     STATUS=$?
     echo "python3 finished with exit status $STATUS and wrote sum.txt into the demo working
     directory"
